text:
Maya: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem on timeouts/partial responses. We need concrete owners, short timelines, and a recurring check to catch regressions. I sketched out four buckets: handshake/backoff, SDK reconnects, telemetry/dashboards, and runbook/SLO changes.

Sam: I'll take handshake/backoff and server guards. Plan: implement exponential backoff with capped max and jitter, add idempotent handshake token to avoid duplicate sessions, and add a server-side backpressure signal when we hit queueing thresholds. Expect a draft PR in ~48h, canary rollout next week.

Leo: Observability here. I'll add `stream.session.handshakes`, `stream.session.retries`, `stream.partial_responses` (with tags: model, route, region, canary). Also adding a small sampled trace payload (1% via header `x-rw-stream-trace`) and dashboards for rolling 5m/1h rates. ETA: 3 days for metrics + dashboard skeleton.

Toni: SDK owner for reconnect logic and e2e sim. I'll introduce `reconnectStrategy: {type: 'exp', baseMs:100, maxMs:5000}` and a harness that simulates intermittent partials and socket flaps. Will add an integration test `ci/stream-reconnect` that runs in PRs. Target: next Wed for SDK PR.

Eva: I'll update runbook + SLOs. Proposal: add a dedicated partial-response incident page, set alert threshold at partials > 0.15% over 15m and page if >0.5% sustained 30m. Also add a rollback checklist for the handshake canary. Draft done by Thursday.

Raj (oncall): Please coordinate before canary; we need a short maintenance window and an alert mute plan. Also want a temporary synthetic probe hitting streaming endpoints every 10s during rollout.

Sam: Example backoff snippet I'll use (avoid wiggle under 100ms):
```js
const base = 100;
const max = 5000;
const backoff = Math.min(base * Math.pow(2, attempts), max);
const wait = backoff * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5);
await sleep(wait);
```
I'll attach perf microbenchmarks (handshake p50/p95/p99) to the PR.

Leo: Can we add a lightweight event bus topic `stream.events` with `event_type` and `trace_id` for quick joins? I'll add sampling + a compact proto to avoid log noise. Need 2 sample trace ids from the incident to validate.

Maya: Sending two trace ids via DM and adding them to the incident ticket. Fine to enable 1% sampling for 72h for deeper debugging, then revert unless we see PII issues.

Toni: For backwards compatibility, SDK will negotiate reconnect behavior via `clientCapabilities` during handshake. Old clients get `reconnect: disabled` until they upgrade. We'll keep default to exponential.

Eva: On ownership: Sam -> INC-4901 handshake changes (PR+canary), Leo -> INC-4902 telemetry/dashboard, Toni -> INC-4903 SDK+harness, Raj/Eva -> INC-4904 runbook+SLOs and rollout policy.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INC-4901: handshake-backoff-and-server-guard (assignee: Sam).
deploy-bot: Created ticket INC-4902: streaming-telemetry-sampled-traces (assignee: Leo).
deploy-bot: Created ticket INC-4903: sdk-reconnect-simulator-and-tests (assignee: Toni).
deploy-bot: Created ticket INC-4904: partial-response-runbook-and-slos (assignees: Eva,Raj).

Sam: Will include a smoke check that verifies handshake success > 99.5% during canary window and a rollback flag if retries p99 increases by > 2x.

Leo: Dashboard plan: top-level numbers + ability to pivot by model/region/route, and an alert board that surfaces rising partials before paging. I'll share dashboard link once created.

Toni: CI plan: `ci/stream-reconnect` runs 300 simulated sessions with injected partials/socket drops; PR fails if partial rate > 0.5%. Also will publish an SDK migration note.

Eva: Scheduling a 30m sync next Thursday 10:00 PT to review canary readiness, dashboard coverage, and runbook. Please post brief status updates to the incident doc daily until closure.

Maya: Thanks. If anyone needs infra quotas for canary or extra oncall coverage ping me. Let's treat this as high priority until stable. :thumbsup:
